title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：safety　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 safety 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the clerk ① ensured the safety that no applicant in the office would have measured, and he said the ensuring was the whole of the month. The ② safety, meaning the security itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; safety, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of safety in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ safety at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Safety, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the clerk said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the safety was the whole of the matter, meaning the peace and not the security. The ⑥ safety, meaning the peace and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; safety, he said, is either something you ensure or the only word that means both security and a peace. He said the peace is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ safety had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ safety of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of measuring; safety, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ safety I remember is the safety measured in the file, which closed in 1981 and is still measured as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Safety, my mother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all safety, she said, is a peace that has agreed to look like security. She said the peace was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 安全（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 安全（指那分安全本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：ensure the safety 确保这一分安全
D. n. 安全（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 安全之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的安全之事）
F. n. 安全（指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一分）
G. n. 安全、安稳（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安稳（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ensured the safety that no applicant in the office would have measured
The safety, meaning the security itself and not the stamp
Every sort of safety in that office
the safety at the far counter

The safety of the whole thing

answers.why: ensure the safety 意为“确保这一分安全”，1974 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯测量的一分安全做了一遍。
safety 意为“安全”，指那分安全本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
safety 意为“安全”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
safety 意为“安全”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
safety 意为“安全、安稳”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分安稳就是那件事的全部。
safety 意为“安稳”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分安全，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
safety 意为“安全”，指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一分，到 1979 年这一分成了卷宗里的一行。
safety 意为“安全之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的安全之事是一处办事处和三个月份的测量。
safety 意为“安全”，我记得的是卷宗里测量过的那一分，1981 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一分。
safety 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，安全是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的安全。
